text.p: June T-bond futures look positive on Thursday, having completed a reverse head and shoulders pattern on daily charts, and have the potential to reach up to 110-02, technical analysts said.

"The June contract needs to try and hold above 109-00 and target above 109-15, 22 and back up towards 109-25," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London. "A clean break of that level would take us to 110-02."
He said a push up to that level, a 38 percent Fibonacci retracement of the major downmove from 116-00, would look very good for T-bonds.
At 0945 GMT, June T-bond futures were at 109-10, up 1/32 in automated trade. The contract has traded up strongly over the last two sessions from a low of 107-04.
On daily charts 109-25 was the high on March 25 and Celaya said a base in the region of 109-25 to 110-02 would set up T-bonds to make gains up to 112-00.
But if 109-00 failed to support the market, Celaya said there were few props until around 108-00.
"You could probably look for a move all the way down to 108-00 zone and maybe a little lower to 107-30, 31," he said.
Charles Diebel, senior fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London, agreed T-bonds were in a good technical position.
"They have clearly broken higher from their recent range and are heading for the mid-March highs at 109-25," he said.
"The only real problem being that daily momentum is shifting lower again so it tends to suggest gains to that area should be sold."
Short-term, he said the contract was definitely over bought and something of a set back was overdue.
"But nothing too remarkable and we should find some support initally at 109-00, then the really good level is down at yesterday's low at 108-12," he said.
At the short end September Eurodollar futures were at 93.875, unchanged in automated trade.
